$comment: Canonical Nostr wire contract between ndisc (publisher) and the glmps web viewers (consumers) for the record-label image library. UNFROZEN — promoted to frozen + SHA-pinned (mirroring release.v1.json) once ndisc implements publishing.

d.note: Fixed identifier — exactly one label-library event per author. The disco-vault: prefix matches release.v1's convention.

alt.note: NIP-31 human-readable description. Recommended: 'ndisc record-label image library'.

labels.keys: Label name string. Matched verbatim (case-sensitive, whitespace-significant) against the `label` tag value on release events (kind:31237).

parent.note: Sublabels. The parent label's name: another key of this map, or a label that only appears as the `label` tag on release events. Matched like `label` (verbatim; ndisc emits the parent's stored spelling). One level only: a label that is some entry's parent never has a `parent` of its own, and no entry is its own parent. Children are derived by inverting the map — nothing lists them. An entry may carry `parent` with no `image` (a sublabel without art).

label_library.rule: Consumers MUST tolerate missing entries — fall back to a generic glyph. Consumers MUST tolerate extra fields inside each value object — forward-compatible (e.g. `country`, `founded`, `website` may be added in labels.v2). Consumers MUST tolerate an entry without `image` (one that carries only `parent`): show no art for it. A consumer that ignores `parent` sees exactly what it saw before the amendment — readers that keep only entries with a string `image` (glmps, nview as of 2026-11-26) silently skip image-less entries.
amendments: 2026-11-26 — optional `parent` (sublabels); `image` optional when `parent` is present. Additive: schemaVersion stays labels.v1. Design: docs/sublabels-design-2026-11-26.md.
